title: Cessna 120 caught in helicopter wake turbulence
description:
On Jan. 3, 2022, a Cessna 120 pilot lost control during a go-around as it encountered wake turbulence from a slow hover taxiing helicopter at Upland-Cable Airport (CCB).
More info: https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/273729
Video: NTSB Docket WPR22LA072
